name: Find Your Agent

sources.title: Homepage — live directory of 200+ AI agents by category; prominent banner: 'findyouragent.ai is looking for a new owner — Make an offer'
Submit Agent route — auth-gated sign-in page (Google OAuth or email/password)

requirements: Account required: sign up via Google OAuth or email/password at /users/sign_up
Directory is for AI agents/assistants — categories include content creation, design, productivity, dev tools, marketing, BI, e-commerce, personal assistant
No paid listing option observed; submission appears free
preparation: Agent name, URL, description, category, tags, and pricing model (listings show 'Free + from $X/month' format)
workflow: Register or sign in at https://findyouragent.ai/users/sign_in
Open https://findyouragent.ai/agents/new and fill in the agent details
Agent appears under Browse Agents and its category once live
watchFor: The site is actively FOR SALE ('looking for a new owner') — continuity of listings and maintenance is uncertain
Submit form fields not visible without auth
Low-barrier catalog with many thin listings; modest quality signal
countsAsLive: The agent has a public detail page under findyouragent.ai/agents/ visible in its category
unknowns: Whether submissions are reviewed before publishing
Who operates the site during the ownership transition
Whether the directory will persist under a new owner
